world_fit_review.observations: Large rounded head, compact upright torso, two arm-paws beside belly and two short supporting feet, simple oval cream-sclera eyes and gentle smile. Warm brown contour and delicate textured colour blocks fit siamese-cat/hedgehog/tora cast; no natural quadruped stance.
